name: Dihydrotestosterone
summary: Dihydrotestosterone is an endogenous androgen sex steroid and hormone primarily involved in the growth and repair of the prostate and the penis, as well as the production of sebum and body hair composition.

pharmacology.text: DHT is a potent agonist of the androgen receptor (AR), and is the AR's most potent known endogenous ligand. It has an affinity (Kd) of 0.25 to 0.5 nM for the human AR, which is about 2- to 3-fold higher than that of testosterone (Kd = 0.4 to 1.0 nM) and 15–30 times higher than that of adrenal androgens. In addition, the dissociation rate of DHT from the AR is 5-fold slower than that of testosterone.

body.says: Oral: very low (due to extensive first pass metabolism)

uses.text: DHT is available in pharmaceutical formulations for medical use as an androgen or anabolic–androgenic steroid (AAS). It is used mainly in the treatment of male hypogonadism. When used as a medication, dihydrotestosterone is referred to as androstanolone (INN) or as stanolone (BAN), and is sold under brand names such as Andractim among others.
uses.routes: Transdermal (gel), in the cheek, under the tongue, intramuscular injection (as esters)
